### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>zizmorcore/zizmor-action</summary>

### [`v0.8.0`](https://redirect.github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor-action/releases/tag/v0.8.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor-action/compare/v0.7.1...v0.8.0)

The action now supports prereleases.

The default has not changed, but you can pass a prerelease version
of zizmor or `version: prerelease` to get whatever latest
prerelease the action knows about.

#### What's Changed

- Support prereleases by [@​woodruffw](https://redirect.github.com/woodruffw) in [#​182](https://redirect.github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor-action/pull/182)
- Sync zizmor versions by [@​github-actions](https://redirect.github.com/github-actions)\[bot] in [#​184](https://redirect.github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor-action/pull/184)

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor-action/compare/v0.7.1...v0.8.0>

</details>
